payload.content: An electrical-services WordPress website helping homeowners and businesses navigate installations, lighting, PV, batteries, heat pumps and maintenance before requesting advice or a quotation.
payload.description_1: Dmelektro works for homeowners and businesses that may arrive with an electrical problem, an installation project or a maintenance need. Those situations require different information, and a broad list of electrical services would not help visitors judge urgency, scope or the right next step.
payload.description_2: I shaped Dmelektro around the type of electrical need rather than a single generic service page. Installation work, maintenance and other technical support have clear routes, with practical information introduced where it helps someone understand what to describe in an enquiry.
